body.condition: Every value, table row, parent coordinate, allowed output, graph edge, actual value, and rational cost is explicitly indexed and contributes to \(L\) or \(B\).

novel.justification: Complete local support tables are a realistic backend input for finite categorical systems, finite-state controllers, and tabular causal simulators; this novel encoding convention makes every allowed outcome auditable and is not attributed as a standard assumption of either Beckers or Eiter--Lukasiewicz.
